text: Convex is a reactive database where you write queries as TypeScript code that runs inside the database, no SQL needed
quote: Convex is the open source, reactive database where queries are TypeScript code running right in the database.

text: Optional schemas let you enforce a specific shape for your documents
quote: Though optional, schemas ensure that your data looks exactly how you want.

text: Convex Auth library supports social login, one-time email/SMS codes, and password sign-in for React and React Native apps
quote: you can implement auth directly in Convex with the Convex Auth library... helps you build a custom sign-up/sign-in flow via social identity providers, one-time email or SMS access codes, or via passwords.

text: Documented integration guidance for using Clerk, WorkOS AuthKit, or Auth0 as auth providers with strong Next.js/React Native support
quote: Clerk has great Next.js and React Native support ... WorkOS AuthKit is built for B2B apps ... Auth0 is more established with more bells and whistles

text: Local dev server watches the filesystem and live-pushes function/schema changes to your dev deployment
quote: Watches the local filesystem. When you change a function or the schema, the new versions are pushed to your dev deployment

text: Generated TypeScript types in convex/_generated are automatically updated when schema or functions change
quote: Watches the local filesystem. When you change a function or the schema, the new versions are pushed to your dev deployment and the generated types in convex/_generated are updated.

text: Vector search finds similar documents using embedding vectors, useful for LLM context and recommendations
quote: Vector search allows you to find Convex documents similar to a provided vector... enable you to provide useful context to LLMs for AI powered applications

text: Self-hosted Convex runs the same open-source backend code as the managed cloud service
quote: you can run the Convex backend on your own servers. Self-hosted Convex runs the open-source backend, and contains the same fully up-to-date code the cloud service uses.

text: Self-hosted Convex works with common infrastructure like Neon, Fly.io, Vercel, Netlify, RDS, SQLite, Postgres, and more
quote: Self-hosted Convex works well with a variety of tools including Neon, Fly.io, Vercel, Netlify, RDS, Sqlite, Postgres, and more.

text: Public Convex functions are exposed as HTTP endpoints that return the function's result as a value
quote: These HTTP endpoints allow you to call Convex functions and get the result as a value.

text: An official Convex MCP server exposes tools that let AI agents interact with a Convex deployment
quote: The Convex Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides several tools that allow AI agents to interact with your Convex deployment.

text: Convex Components are sandboxed, open-source building blocks that add complex functionality without building it from scratch
quote: Convex Components are sandboxed, open-source building blocks for your app. They let you add complex functionality to your app without implementing everything from scratch.

text: ACID transactions ensure concurrent writes never corrupt data
quote: ACID transactions so concurrent writes never corrupt your data

text: Tables are created implicitly the moment the first document is inserted, with no upfront table setup
quote: Your Convex deployment contains tables that hold your app's data. Initially, your deployment contains no tables or documents. Each table springs into existence as soon as you add the first document to it.

text: Official CLI command to run a public or internal Convex function against a development deployment
quote: npx convex run <functionName> [args] — Run a public or internal Convex query, mutation, or action on your development deployment.

text: Vendor provides an agent-oriented setup doc (agent-setup.md) to make coding agents 'Convex experts'
quote: Make your agent a Convex expert: Get Convex-ready by following https://www.convex.dev/agent-setup.md

text: Real-time sync automatically pushes the latest data to connected clients
quote: Real-time sync so your users instantly see the latest data

text: Designed to work smoothly with coding agents for scaffolding new apps
quote: Convex works great with coding agents. Starting a new project is as easy as asking your agent to create a new app with Convex.

text: Convex avoids requiring an opinionated row-level-security framework, unlike client-oriented databases such as Firebase/Supabase
quote: Convex doesn't need an opinionated authorization framework like RLS, which is required in client oriented databases like Firebase or Supabase.

text: CLI command to import data from a file directly into a deployment
quote: `npx convex import` — Import data from a file to your deployment

text: CLI command shows health insights for a deployment
quote: `npx convex insights` — Show health insights for your deployment

text: MCP server is blocked from accessing production deployments by default, as a safety measure
quote: By default, the MCP server cannot access production deployments. This is a safety measure to prevent accidental modifications to production data.

text: Convex's flexible authorization model lets developers build a custom authorization framework suited to their needs
quote: which is required in client oriented databases like Firebase or Supabase. This flexibility lets you build and use an authorization framework for your needs.

text: End-to-end type safety catches agent-introduced errors (hallucinations) before they reach production
quote: End-to-end type safety so agent hallucinations are caught before they ship
